fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) declined 7.2% on November 13, 2026, primarily due to AI stock weakness following Nvidia disruption.
fields.summary_ko.1: Dell's AI server revenue represented $16.4 billion (35%) of total fiscal 2027 Q2 revenue (ended July 31, 2026) of $47 billion, with AI backlog reaching record $95 billion.
